notes.title: NecroCity Now in Full Release! 🔥
notes.notes:
It's time to face the forces of so-called 'good' ⚔️

THE FULL VERSION of NecroCity is Now Available! 🥳

Get ready to embark on an epic journey into the heart of darkness, build your Undead Kingdom, and take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself in the world of the Undead Kingdom! 👹

[previewyoutube=1hurF3oLI40;full][/previewyoutube]

The entire NecorCity Team is incredibly happy to announce that the full version of the game is now available to play. After several months of hard work, dedication, and extremely valuable feedback from our community, we decided to release the game in the Full Version! 🎊


Major Changes from Early Access to Full Version 😈
 9 new levels
 3 maps in the new Endless Mode
 A new mode in minimap - follow
 Added Steam Cloud 
 Added the ability to upgrade traps
 New biome
 More markings on the minimap
 Keyboard shortcuts for building
 UI scaling
 Improved text readability
 Improved tower upgrades
 Obelisks do not require connection to each other
 Improved spell cost
 Gameplay balance changes
 Fixed incorrect game detection by Steam
 Bugfixes
 The entire plot is fully readyAND MORE


Thank You - For being with us during this time! 🤝
We would like to thank every player who was with us, for your support, feedback, opinions, bug reports, and suggestions. We started with a demo and after several months of hard work, we released the Full Version of the game - this couldn't happen without your commitment.


What's next for the Kingdom of the Undead? 🤔
Our adventure through the World of the Undead does not end here. We will continue to maintain our game and make improvements based on your feedback and suggestions. Therefore, we encourage you to share your opinion about the game and write your feedback to us.

🔥 Start Your Adventure in the World of the Undead Now! 🔥


Join our community on Discord, where you can talk to us directly 👇

Have Fun!
NecroCity Team

notes.title: NecroCity Release of the Full Version! 👹
notes.notes:
Attention Necromancers! 🧙‍♂️

The Time Has Come! ⚔️

Grab your torches and get ready for the premiere later this week 🥳


We are really proud to announce that the Full Version of NecroCity will be available on:
October 26, 2023, at 12:00 PM CEST! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/e32adb0d3c1a280111d5cf3cc08d74940c68b68e.jpg

Over the last few months since the release of the Early Access version, we have refined the most important aspects of the gameplay. During this time, we collected feedback from you and implemented and improved a lot in the gameplay of NecroCity.

We are looking forward to the premiere! 💪

Do you have any questions? Join our community on Discord, where you can talk to us directly 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/843dc6ddc2ff62506d346c0d3a4cf9e1149c5d47.png

See you soon,
NecroCity Team

notes.title: RELEASE DATE SET! 🔥
notes.notes:
Welcome Necromancers! 🧙‍♂️

The day has come! We are launching NecroCity in Early Access at the beginning of April!

Get ready at:
April 5th, 2023! 🔥

You can check out our Road Map - in points, we explain what you can expect in the Early Access and Full Version of the game. Of course, this is not all we have prepared, we will constantly take care of every reported bug and game stability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/a1781a98829a9587dd1ae33d248e26cd867b1de0.png

We decided to release the game in Early Access because after the prologue we got positive feedback from our community and thanks to that we already know which way the full version of the game should go. This requires another few months of work from us, which is why we decided to release the game in Early Access.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/843dc6ddc2ff62506d346c0d3a4cf9e1149c5d47.png

See you soon,
NecroCity Team
